e924f5db30bbaf936266a4d8ed5e690f1bafb143.title: Women of Wizards joins the Gathering Grounds schedule
e924f5db30bbaf936266a4d8ed5e690f1bafb143.summary: The official Atlanta schedule added Women of Wizards Commander Pods on Friday, November 13, noon–2 PM, and Learn to Play / Pod Pairing on Saturday, November 14, noon–2 PM, both in The Gathering Grounds. The listings describe 16 and 8 player spots respectively; check official details for participation instructions.
